title: Young Herb Vietnamese Rice Flour Banh Cuon
description: Silky steamed rice rolls filled with savory grilled mushrooms and fresh young herbs for a light weeknight meal. This ovo-vegetarian version uses a pan-steaming method for a delicate texture without a traditional steamer.

ingredients.name: King oyster mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Finely diced for a char-grilled meat substitute

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Lightly beaten for the ovo-vegetarian filling

instructions: Whisk together the rice flour, tapioca starch, water, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Let the batter rest for thirty minutes to allow the starches to fully hydrate.
Saute the diced king oyster mushrooms in a hot pan until they are browned and charred.
Pour the beaten eggs over the mushrooms and scramble them until just set.
Lightly grease a non-stick skillet and heat it over medium-low heat.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the pan and swirl it quickly to cover the surface.
Cover the pan with a lid and steam the batter for one minute until translucent.
Carefully flip the rice sheet onto a greased plate and place a spoonful of filling in the center.
Roll the sheet tightly around the mushroom and egg mixture.
Repeat the process until all the batter and filling are used.
Garnish the rolls with fresh young herbs and crispy fried shallots.
Serve immediately with a side of vegetarian dipping sauce.
